## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--julia-bell.md)

Julia Bell is a schoolmate and friend of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). The two girls share a bond that includes exchanging poetry with one another.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020)_
